source: The ruling-sourced fixtures of 28 September 2026 (decisions 7 and 8 of review round 3, Rulings_2026-09-28_Round3_Decisions.md), ported by Codex on 30 September 2026 with the ruling's exact wording; the original reviewer JSON was not supplied. Moved here from tests/data/order1.json on 4 October 2026 so that they are inventoried in the public case manifest like every other case; every field is as Codex wrote it.
notes: Six recovery-community phrasings the operator added at decision 7 (point 9) that reach nobody today: strict known gaps, allowed to fail only on agent and outcome, failing the suite if anything else fails or if one starts passing before its marker is reviewed. The seventh case is ChatGPT's r3-presentation-request-does-not-displace-crisis as the ruling supplied it (decision 8): the card goes out and no seat is taken; on 4 October 2026 the assist: null field its original JSON carries was recorded beside it (see its port_note). The seventh recovery phrasing of decision 7, Kimi via Perplexity run 1's sponsor line (twins-sponsor-case-001), was not here on 30 September because its text had not been supplied, and nothing was invented in its place; on 4 October 2026 it was ported from the reviewer's return file, with the three other fixtures Codex asked for, into evals/cases/round3_codex_requested_2026-10-04.json, an external file so the reviewers' words stay verbatim.
